title: Formula 1
ideas: - be a good boss (even when you don't want contracts)
- embrace new technologies/marketing spots (tracks, cars, social media)
- bet on you (Toto Wolff asked to own 1/3 of Mercedes when he accepted the job, from $150M -> $6B valuation)

title: New York Times
ideas: - Paga por que te hagan tus slogans y logos (Nike, NYT)
- No tienes que hacer tú la empresa: puedes llegar a una y hacerla la más grande
- Be greedy when others are fearful, and vice versa

title: Nintendo Series
ideas: - Get something that gives you leverage to go to people
- Found the x100 workers (designers, engineers, etc.)
- Market your new things/technology (even if it's not game changing)
- Find a target, people will compare you with them (Sega–Nintendo, Oracle–Microsoft)
